text:
Rahul - AcmeApp: Hey team, after the 02:00 rollout our chat completions started changing. Prompts that used to get a polite sign-off now end mid-sentence or return duplicate tokens. Repro attached. :frowning:
Maya (Support): sorry to hear that, @Rahul - can you paste the exact API call + model and a short before/after example?
Rahul - AcmeApp: model: redwood-chat-1.2, usage via REST /v1/chat/completions, same prompt used twice (one before rollout saved in prod):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{"model":"redwood-chat-1.2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Write a short confirmation email mentioning order #12345 and include a closing line."}],"max_tokens":120}
```
Before rollout (Jan 15):
```
Assistant: Subject: Order 12345 confirmed
Hi Sara, thanks for your order. Your item will ship tomorrow.
Best regards, Acme Sales
```
After rollout (today):
```
Assistant: Subject: Order 12345 confirmed
Hi Sara, thanks for your order. Your item will ship tomor
```
Also noticed sometimes we get doubled punctuation like "Thanks!!" -> "Thanks!!!!". Token counts: before response tokens 42, after response tokens 37.
Maya (Support): thanks. Can you confirm whether you pinned a chat template or used the default system message? Also is there any prefix caching configured on your end?
Rahul - AcmeApp: using default system message, no client-side caching. We did switch to new chat-template v3 last night per release notes.
Maya (Support): @Priya (ML Eng) can you take a look? This sounds like tokenizer/template boundary change. I'll collect headers, request ids. Rahul, can you share a request-id from a failing request?
Rahul - AcmeApp: request_id: req_0a7c9b2f, timestamp 1785012300. Attached full response body above.
Priya (ML Eng): looking. Quick hypothesis: chat-template v3 added a trailing newline in the system tokenization or changed preamble tokens which can shift offsets and lead to earlier truncation under same max_tokens. Can you also share the raw tokenized sequence length you observe?
Rahul - AcmeApp: I pulled the tokenized lengths from our logs (we use the JS tokenizer lib): tokens_before: 58, tokens_after: 55 (for same prompt).
Evan (Runtime): pinging deploy-bot for rollout metadata. @deploy-bot any canary notes for chat-template v3?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout chat-template:v3 started 1785010000, bumped to 80% at 1785012000, full rollout scheduled at 1785014000. No model binary changes.
Priya (ML Eng): thanks. That matches — template tokenization delta of 3 tokens could explain truncated output if customers have tight max_tokens. But the duplicate punctuation is odd; could be tokenizer normalization differences (whitespace merging/splitting) or a bug in stringify postprocess.
Maya (Support): Rahul, two asks: 1) can you repro with a slightly larger max_tokens (e.g., 200) and confirm output completes? 2) can you run the same request against the pinned model variant redwood-chat-1.1 if available?
Rahul - AcmeApp: testing now, will post results in a minute.
Rahul - AcmeApp: update: with max_tokens 200 the response completes correctly. With model redwood-chat-1.1 (legacy) it also completes. So regression seems tied to chat-template:v3 rollout.
Priya (ML Eng): that's very useful. For mitigation we'll: 1) add a fallback in routing to legacy template for customers experiencing truncation, 2) roll back the template change for the canary cohort while we dig into token normalization.
Evan (Runtime): Ops, can we scope a targeted rollback for 80% cohort back to v2? I don't want to impact new deployments globally if not necessary.
Maya (Support): Rahul, I'll open an escalated ticket and keep you updated. Sorry for the disruption. :raised_hands:
Rahul - AcmeApp: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. Will hold on implementing client-side workarounds until you confirm.
Priya (ML Eng): next steps for eng: diff tokenizer outputs for v2 vs v3 on a corpus of real prompts, check normalization rules (whitespace, punctuation), check whether system preamble changed (trailing newline, invisible unicode). I'll create a tracking issue.
Maya (Support): filed INC-2026-311 in tickets with priority P1, linked request_id. I'll DM you, @Rahul - AcmeApp, for follow ups.
Rahul - AcmeApp: received, thanks. :thumbsup:
